scope: Selected structural_adaptive_ecc source, chiefly stream_entry_assemble lines139-168 read whole; earlier combined output truncated, so no whole-file claim. Exact original AST functions compute_ecc_params, feature_scaling and stream_entry_assemble executed in isolation without modifying bodies. Not module/backend integration.

findings.detail: Loop checks cursor before read but does not cap hash+ECC read to remaining entry bytes. Truncated entry can consume following marker/metadata into current ECC block; reproduced by exact function extraction and authored BytesIO input. This confirms local parser boundary violation, not whole-file repair corruption or exploitability.

Function stops when source message read returns empty; declared filesize is used for rate scaling, not as a hard remaining source bound. Track boundary controls iteration, so independent size/entry consistency checks must be established in callers.
If track ends before source, function prints a warning after generator loop, rather than returning a typed incomplete status. Consumers must exhaust generator to even observe warning.
